subject: CryptoPkg: BaseCryptLib: Reject empty X.509 cert when retrieving public key
reasons: Adds an identical early-return guard (if CertSize == 0 -> set context to NULL, return FALSE) to two functions in the same file: RsaGetPublicKeyFromX509 and EcGetPublicKeyFromX509
The pattern is structurally identical in both instances: check CertSize == 0, null out the output context pointer, return FALSE
Could be part of a broader pattern if other X.509 or crypto API entry points in BaseCryptLib also lack this guard - making it a collateral evolution candidate
The repeated within-file duplication is an exact structural match suitable for Coccinelle
